definitions.explanation: A group of things tied or wrapped together.

examples.english: I bought a bunch of flowers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{束|たば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To organize the documents into bundles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{札束|さつたば}→札束：15926_satsutaba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧。
examples.english: To count a stack of bills.

notes:
{束|たば} refers to a group of things tied, wrapped, or held together.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{花束|はなたば}→花束：03135_hanataba⟧: bouquet, bunch of flowers
- ⟦{札束|さつたば}→札束：15926_satsutaba⟧: wad of bills, stack of money
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{束|たば}: a lock/bundle of hair

COUNTING PATTERNS:
Also functions as a counter for bundles:
- {一束|ひとたば}: one bundle
- {二束|ふたたば}: two bundles
- {三束|みたば}: three bundles

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {束|たば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bundle together
- {束|たば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|ほど}く→ほどく：10504_hodoku⟧: to untie a bundle
- {束|たば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{縛|しば}る→縛る：03925_shibaru⟧: to tie into a bundle

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
⟦{二束三文|にそくさんもん}→二束三文：06020_nisokusanmon⟧: dirt cheap (literally "two bundles for three mon" — an old coin of tiny value).
